name: popsicle
headline: AUTO-blogger: Your Content Creation
short_description: AUTO-blogger automates WordPress content creation with AI-generated text and images. It integrates with Getty Images, OpenAI DALL-E, and Google Gemini for media. SEO optimization and multi-domain management are included. Ideal for marketing teams managing multiple blogs or websites.
author: AryanVBW

sections.overview: The AUTO-blogger is a powerful Claude Code skill designed specifically for marketing professionals looking to automate their WordPress content management. This skill integrates AI content generation, Getty Images, and SEO optimization, allowing users to create and manage high-quality blog posts effortlessly. With support for OpenAI DALL-E and Google Gemini, AUTO-blogger enhances creative capabilities while managing multiple domains seamlessly. One of the key benefits of the AUTO-blogger is its ability to save time in the content creation process. By automating tasks such as content generation and SEO optimization, users can focus on strategic initiatives rather than getting bogged down in repetitive tasks. Although specific time savings are not quantified, the efficiency gained from this automation can lead to significant productivity improvements for teams. This skill is particularly beneficial for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who are involved in marketing efforts. It serves as an essential tool for those looking to enhance their digital presence without the usual time investment associated with content creation. Whether you're a solo entrepreneur or part of a larger marketing team, AUTO-blogger can streamline your workflow and elevate your content strategy. Implementation of the AUTO-blogger is rated as intermediate, requiring approximately 30 minutes to set up. Users will need a basic understanding of WordPress and AI tools to fully leverage its capabilities. By integrating this skill into your AI-first workflows, you can ensure that your marketing efforts are not only efficient but also innovative, keeping pace with the rapidly evolving digital landscape.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/AryanVBW/AUTO-blogger`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 500-word blog post for [COMPANY] about [TOPIC] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include an engaging introduction, 3-5 key points with subheadings, and a strong call-to-action. Optimize for SEO with relevant keywords like [KEYWORD1], [KEYWORD2], and [KEYWORD3]. Generate 2-3 AI images using DALL-E to accompany the post.
```
